description: Independently authored synthetic evaluation tickets. Three per intent; one negative, neutral and positive formulation per intent. Never used for training or threshold calibration.

cancel_order: This purchase was a mistake and I am upset. Please stop it before it leaves the warehouse.
What steps do I follow to withdraw a purchase that has not shipped?
Thanks for the easy checkout! I no longer need my purchase and would appreciate help stopping it before dispatch.
change_order: I accidentally bought four lamps instead of two. This is frustrating; please help amend the quantity.
Can the colour of a purchased item be changed before shipment?
I love the selection! Could I swap the size on my unshipped purchase?
change_shipping_address: My parcel is headed to my old flat and I am really worried. I need the delivery destination changed.
How can I replace the destination on an existing unshipped purchase?
Thank you for your help! I would like this pending purchase sent to my new home.
check_cancellation_fee: It feels unfair to charge me for withdrawing a purchase. What penalty would I have to pay?
Is there a charge when a purchase is withdrawn before it ships?
I appreciate the clear policies. Could you confirm whether stopping an unshipped purchase costs anything?
check_invoice: The tax figure on my bill looks wrong and this is annoying. Can someone review the amount?
Which details should appear on the bill for my purchase?
Thanks for sending the billing document! Could you help me verify its total?
check_payment_methods: It is irritating that I cannot find this information. Which ways can I pay?
Does checkout support UPI as well as debit cards?
The shop looks great! What payment options are available?
check_refund_policy: I am disappointed with the item. How long do I have to send it back for my money?
What conditions must a product meet to qualify for a return and reimbursement?
Thank you for the helpful service. Could you explain the reimbursement rules before I buy?
complaint: Your service has been awful and nobody has resolved my problem. I want to raise a formal grievance.
Where can I submit a grievance about my recent shopping experience?
I appreciate the agent who listened. Please register my concerns about the service for management review.
contact_customer_service: I have searched everywhere and am fed up. How do I reach the support department?
What email address and hours does the customer-service team use?
Thanks for the useful website! Could you share the support team's contact details?
contact_human_agent: This automated conversation is going nowhere. Let me talk to a person.
Can I speak with a human representative about my issue?
You have been helpful, thank you! May a person take over the conversation?
create_account: It is frustrating having to shop without a profile. How do I open a new membership?
What are the steps to sign up for a shopping profile?
I am excited to join your store! Please explain how to open an account.
delete_account: I am unhappy with this shop and want my entire profile removed permanently.
How do I request permanent removal of my shopping profile?
Thank you for the service over the years. I would now like my account permanently closed.
delivery_options: The shipping choices are confusing and annoying. Is there a faster service?
Which shipment services can I select at checkout?
Great to see you ship locally! Could you describe the available delivery choices?
delivery_period: Waiting without any estimate is frustrating. How many business days does standard shipping usually need?
What is the usual transit time after dispatch?
I am excited for my purchase! How long does express shipping normally take?
edit_account: My surname is displayed incorrectly and it is irritating. Where do I correct my profile?
How can I update the name shown in my personal profile?
Thanks for making the profile simple! Could you show me where to update my contact preferences?
get_invoice: I urgently need the purchase bill and cannot find it anywhere. This is frustrating.
Where can I download the billing document for my dispatched purchase?
Thank you for the prompt dispatch! Could you help me obtain a copy of the invoice?
get_refund: The product is unsuitable and I am disappointed. I want to start the process to get my money back.
How do I begin a return request to receive reimbursement?
I appreciate the service. Please help me initiate a return and reimbursement for an unused item.
newsletter_subscription: These marketing emails are annoying. How do I stop receiving your newsletter?
Where can I enable the email newsletter?
I love your product updates! Please explain how to subscribe to the newsletter.
payment_issue: My bank balance fell but there is no purchase confirmation. I am very upset about this charge.
What should I do if checkout reports a failed transaction?
The shopping experience was great until checkout. I would appreciate help with a payment that did not complete.
place_order: I cannot work out how to buy these items and it is frustrating. How do I complete a purchase?
What steps take items from my basket through purchase confirmation?
I love these products! Please guide me through buying them.
recover_password: I forgot my login secret and am locked out again. This is so frustrating.
How can I regain access when I cannot remember my password?
Thanks for the helpful support! Could you explain how to reset a forgotten password?
registration_problems: The sign-up verification link keeps failing and I am fed up with trying.
What should I do when the activation email link has expired during sign-up?
I am excited to join! Could you help resolve an error in the registration verification step?
review: The product was terrible and I want to publish my experience on its review page.
Where can I leave a product rating after receiving my purchase?
I love the product! How do I publish a five-star review?
set_up_shipping_address: I cannot find where to save my home address and this is annoying. It is for future purchases.
How do I add a new delivery destination to my saved address book?
The account page is great! Could you help me store a second delivery address for later?
switch_account: I am stuck in the wrong profile and it is irritating. How do I move to my other login?
What is the procedure for signing out of one profile and into another?
Thanks for the help! I would like to shop using my other account now.
track_order: My parcel has not arrived and I am very upset. Where can I see its current whereabouts?
Where do I find shipment tracking for my existing purchase?
Thank you for dispatching my purchase! How do I follow its journey?
track_refund: My reimbursement has still not reached my bank and I am angry. Where can I check its progress?
How can I check the status of a reimbursement that was already approved?
Thanks for approving the return! Could you show me how to follow the reimbursement progress?
